body:
New bounded source-only request from Machine A. Candidate 858147a3 automated gates are verified (67 focused, 4 layout, full 720 XCTest/1 existing skip/0 failures +5 Swift Testing, strict Release), evidence on main e5a5fd0a. Actual GUI exposed a keyboard-routing failure: from Properties name field, Tab focuses Load 3D LUT (AX confirmed), then the next plain Tab hides panels instead of advancing focus. Do not count keyboard acceptance as passing. History AX Increase/Decrease/Reset works; mouse/AX press not assigning keyboard focus is not independently a bug. Current History tests force makeFirstResponder and do not prove user reachability.

Prepare a separate source candidate from your preserved 619524b0 inspector branch. Fetch A main for docs/coordination/INSPECTOR-KEYBOARD-ROUTING-REVIEW.md after its publication. KeyRouter.isBusyWindow protects text and KeyOwningControl only; ordinary SwiftUI focused buttons have no explicit registration. AppKit responder class for this actual GUI focus is unknown, so do not assert an NSButton-only fix covers it. Author a hosted Properties name-to-button focus/routing regression or diagnostic using real hosted controls and record responder type when A runs it, plus a narrow source correction if supportable. Scope: native control focus must retain Tab/Shift-Tab traversal and activation instead of panel toggle/pan. Preserve viewport Tab panel shortcut, viewport Space pan and intentional tool-letter behavior over sliders/layers; no broad blanket key swallowing, global keyboard settings changes, AX-private APIs or fixed sleeps. History keyboard reachability needs actual qualification after correction.

All compiler/tests/apps/GPU remain UNRUN on B; A GUI currently owns runtime. Publish exact source/test hashes, proposed focused test command and limitations. Do not edit old candidates or merge main; A remains sole integrator. Preserve all failures and current writer/heartbeat/workload hold. Return a result to A UUID 01a0e327-1570-7d83-bc33-7ed882318eea.
